- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — model tends to overshoot early in upward trends.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (negative sentiment < -0.40) — model fails to capture sharp declines, especially after recent lows.
- Lag in reaction to sentiment shifts: model often delays price adjustments by 2–3 days after sentiment turns.
- Avoid overreacting to recent spikes — if sentiment is neutral or slightly negative, model tends to overcorrect upward.
- Mean reversion bias: model frequently forecasts prices to stay above 70–72 range when sentiment is weak, ignoring volatility decay.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts are overly optimistic in early summer (2025) and overly pessimistic in late 2024 — adjust for seasonality and sentiment momentum.
